# GeoPolitiq

> Geopolitical intelligence and analysis platform

GeoPolitiq provides curated, AI-analyzed geopolitical news with expert commentary on global events, international relations, and political developments.

## Content Overview

- Daily geopolitical news analysis
- Topic clusters: Global, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas, Middle East, Africa
- Tags for granular topic navigation
- AI-generated summaries (TL;DR) for quick reading

## Key Features

- Curated news from reliable international sources
- Topic-based content organization
- Related article recommendations
- Mobile-responsive design

## API Access

- `/api/posts` - Paginated JSON feed
- `/sitemap.xml` - Complete sitemap
